{{Quote|Clan Cadera started an uprising against Mandalore the Vindicated. Refused to side with the Sith. Refused the call by their leader. To them, it was a matter of honor. [The banner's] a symbol of rebellion.|Jekiah Ordo, on the significance of the Clan Cadera banner|<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" />}}
The '''banner''' of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Cadera]] was a symbol guarded by [[Mandalore the Avenger]]'s [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|faction]]. In [[3626 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.2}}</ref> the [[Hidden Chain]] [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|attacked]] Mandalore the Avenger's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance II]]'' and stole the banner.<ref name="Spirit of Vengeance" /> Prior to her [[Showdown on Ruhnuk|duel]] against Mandalore on [[Ruhnuk]], [[Field Marshal]] [[Heta Kol]] set the Cadera banner ablaze in full view of her followers as a statement against the Mandalorians bowing to any galactic power.<ref name="Outside Interference">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Outside Interference|[[Ruhnuk]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Gameplay alternatives===
If [[Torian Cadera]] survived the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion, '''Chapter VIII: The End Times''', he will have special cutscenes involving the Cadera banner. In the companion mission, "'''What Remains of Clan Cadera'''", Torian collected the remains of the Cadera banner, believing it wasn't right that Heta Kol had the last word on it. While he agrees that the banner is a symbol of shame and betrayal, he found it audacious that she burned it. He decides to keep the remains as a reminder of his [[Jicoln Cadera|father]], his clan and his sense of a right and wrong, and for future consideration if he required peace of mind.<ref name="WRCC">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|What Remains of Clan Cadera|[[Odessen]]}}</ref>
